definition.simple: The pattern of swing highs and swing lows on a chart, used to describe whether price is trending or moving sideways.
definition.balanced: Higher highs and higher lows describe an uptrend. Lower highs and lower lows describe a downtrend. Overlapping swings describe a range. When an uptrend makes a new low below its last higher low, people say the structure is broken. That is a change in description, not a promise that price will now fall.
